💡 Conclusion & Key Findings (Table 3.3)
  • Starch is present in Potato, Boiled rice, and Bread / Chapati (turns blue-black with iodine).
  • Fats are present in Crushed peanuts, Butter, Coconut, and Cooking oil (leaves an oily translucent patch on paper).
  • Proteins are present in Boiled gram and Crushed peanuts (turns violet with copper sulfate & caustic soda).
  • ⭐ Special Discovery: Peanuts contain BOTH protein and fat! A single food item can provide more than one nutrient.
